caption:
Turn messy meeting notes into a clear plan. 📝

Paste your notes and ask: "Sort these into decisions, action items (owner and date), and open questions. Use only what is in the notes."

The last sentence stops AI from inventing tasks. 📌 Save this prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitips #aitools #meetingnotes #productivity #worksmarter #techtips #techmendly
